details: Spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs saw combined inflows of approximately $1.1 billion for the week ending August 7th, marking the strongest demand since April. BlackRock's IBIT led with $853.54 million in Bitcoin ETF inflows. This institutional interest follows weaker-than-expected July jobs data, reducing expectations for Federal Reserve rate hikes. The market is now keenly awaiting the US July Consumer Price Index (CPI) data on August 12th, which is expected to be a major catalyst. A cooler-than-expected CPI could extend institutional bullish sentiment, while a hotter print might reverse inflows and pressure crypto prices. Bitcoin has held near $65,293, and Ethereum near $1,926, indicating stability in major assets.
title: Institutional ETF Inflows Surge Ahead of Key US Inflation Data

details: Bitcoin's largest holders, often referred to as "whales," have transitioned from selling to accumulating BTC after offloading approximately $40 billion since October 2025. This shift, combined with crypto funds logging a fifth straight week of inflows totaling $1.05 billion, historically signals the potential end of a price cycle's low point. This trend suggests a change in sentiment among large-scale investors, moving towards accumulation.
title: Bitcoin Whale Selling Ends, Accumulation Phase Begins

details: While Bitcoin and Ethereum remained largely range-bound, Solana (SOL) climbed to approximately $77, reaching its highest level since July 27th. This outperformance has attracted attention from analysts, with some suggesting a potential target of $100 for SOL, supported by technical signals like a MACD golden cross and a TD Sequential buy signal.
title: Solana (SOL) Outperforms Majors, Reaching Two-Week High

details: The US Senate's "Crypto Clarity Act," a highly anticipated market structure bill, has been delayed again. A crucial procedural vote is now expected on September 15th, with investment bank TD Securities assigning only a 25% chance of the bill passing this fall. This delay and the low probability of passage introduce continued regulatory uncertainty for the crypto market, particularly for Ethereum and stablecoin projects.
title: CLARITY Act Faces Further Delays, Slim Chance of Passing This Fall

details: Recent security incidents include a reported Coldcard exploit leading to an estimated $110-$130 million in Bitcoin theft, and a critical vulnerability discovered in BTCPay Server. Additionally, Coinsbuy wallets were drained of $7.9 million. These incidents underscore ongoing security challenges and the importance of robust security practices for crypto users and platforms.
title: Coldcard Exploit and BTCPay Server Flaw Highlight Security Risks
